tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Substring + memory-trigger search over MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and any indexed session transcripts). Required recall step before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files. Returns the top-K matching entries with paths and excerpt lines.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Substring (or memory trigger phrase) to search for.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Safe exact excerpt read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md. Returns a bounded excerpt with truncation info when more content exists, and `corpus=wiki` reads from registered compiled-wiki supplements.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the memory file (relative to the workspace).
